title: Aromatic Amber Egyptian Chicken Tagine
description: A funky and flavorful one-pot Egyptian dish featuring sugar syrup and yakimono-grill, perfect for a special occasion, this FODMAP-friendly recipe is sure to impress
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large yakimono-grill or tagine over medium-high heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes
Add the sugar syrup, yakimono-grill sauce, ginger paste, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25-30 minutes
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve the tagine hot over rice or couscous
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
